title: RBAC v2 migration — phased dual-write validation, targeted backfills, and incremental cutover
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Migrate tenants from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2 with minimal customer disruption and full audit preservation. This ticket defines a migration blueprint covering dual-write validation, selective backfills, incremental cutover windows, rollback criteria, and customer communications. It explicitly includes how SSO/SAML role mappings and admin controls should be reconciled and audited during each phase.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write mode enabled and verified for 20% of orgs with no data divergence for 72 hours
Backfill tool completed for a test cohort (50 orgs) and reconciled with primary DB within 1% discrepancy tolerance
Cutover runbook tested in staging and one customer pilot; ability to rollback within 30 minutes documented
Audit events for role changes and mappings are recorded to centralized audit-log with immutable IDs and are queryable by console and SIEM
SSO/SAML automated mapping script handles edge cases (missing attributes, multiple role assertions) and exposes mapping warnings in admin UI
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Pre-migration verification (schema checks, audit pipeline dry-run); Phase 1: Enable dual-write for internal test orgs; Phase 2: Pilot external customers (opt-in) + targeted backfills; Phase 3: Broad dual-write + automated backfill waves; Phase 4: Read-only v1 deprecation window; Phase 5: Cutover and finalization with post-cutover monitoring and audit reconciliation.
test_matrix: Data integrity: compare role assignments and permission grants between v1 and v2 across sample orgs
Failure injection: DB write failures, partial latency spikes — ensure atomicity guarantees or compensating actions
SSO flows: SAML login with multiple role assertions, missing attributes, and role name collisions
Admin actions: create/update/delete role templates in v2 while v1 still writable — observe audit stream correctness
runbook_steps: 1) Preflight: run schema validation tool and snapshot v1 role tables
2) Enable dual-write feature flag for cohort A (internal) and monitor kafka audit topic for divergence alerts
3) Run incremental backfill for cohort A using backfill service with concurrency throttles
4) Reconcile using diff tool; if >1% mismatch, pause and run targeted reconcile job
5) Expand to pilot customers after 72h stable runs; schedule maintenance windows with customers where necessary
6) Final cutover: promote v2 as primary write path, switch admin console to read/write v2 and continue shadow-writing v1 for 24h
7) Post-cutover: run audit reconciliation, export immutable audit bundle for compliance teams, and decommission v1 writes per policy
observability_and_alerting: Metric: backfill_throughput and backfill_error_rate -> oncall alert at P1
Audit log ingestion lag -> warning when >5m
SSO mapping errors count -> dashboard and daily digest to security team
known_risks: Edge-case role name collisions causing incorrect permission grants
Large orgs with millions of role assignments causing backfill duration > maintenance window
SSO attribute mismatches leading to orphaned admin users post-cutover
Audit pipeline outages losing visibility during critical migration steps
mitigations: Pre-migration role-normalization utility to canonicalize role names
Chunked backfills with resumable checkpoints and customer opt-in for extended windows
Add mapping warnings to admin console and blockcutover flag for orgs with unresolved mapping issues
Circuit-breaker that pauses cutover and notifies SE/Oncall if audit pipeline lag exceeds threshold
